title: Made a daily football quiz with Claude where the obvious answer loses, would love some feedback
author: VikkeboiFN
selftext:
Hey, I've been working on a little football game called Kickoro for the past few weeks, mostly with the help of Claude, and it's finally live. It currently has a few hundred daily players, which is pretty crazy to me.

The game is basically a daily football quiz with 6 questions. For example, you might get "Name a manager who has won the Premier League". Any correct answer works, but the less common your answer is, the further you kick the ball. So answering Ferguson won't get you very far, but naming a manager hardly anyone else thought of might send it flying. You get 25 seconds for each question.

I've used Claude for most of the coding, coming up with ideas and making changes along the way. AI also helped research possible answers for the questions, but I've gone through and checked them myself. Everything visual, including the pixel art and animations, is made in code.

I'd really like to hear what people think. Is the idea easy to understand when you first play? Is anything confusing or just not fun? And what would make you want to come back and play every day?

It's free and you don't need an account. If anyone wants to try it, it's here:

[kickoro](https://kickoro.io/?src=aigamedev)

Appreciate any feedback!
